disclosure: Real automated browser footage, with planned navigation, English captions and an installed synthetic English voice. Recorded history is labeled. No paid model result is represented.

chapters.title: Can a database evolve an interface?
captions: Can an Oracle database evolve a user interface? APEX Genesis turns that question into a small, inspectable experiment. The database owns every generation.
These are real rendered dashboards, built from constrained JSON genomes. Metrics, filters, revenue and orders remain present while structure and presentation change.
The public exhibition replays recorded Oracle results. It does not connect to the development database, and it cannot trigger paid model requests.
This demonstration uses actual software and synthetic business data. Navigation is planned, captions are added, and the English narration uses an installed synthetic voice.

chapters.title: The Oracle-owned lifecycle
captions: Oracle APEX is the authenticated control center. A dedicated schema stores experiments, immutable genomes, evaluations, parents, events and durable generation boundaries.
Here a small real run advances through PL/SQL selection, compatible crossover and bounded mutation. A browser worker supplies measured observations at three viewport sizes.
The scheduler creates a new generation only after the current evaluations are complete. An open browser tab is not required for database orchestration.
Pause, resume and stop are explicit database transitions. Pending browser evaluations remain visible. A missing worker never becomes animated fictional progress.

chapters.title: From genotype to a working interface
captions: An organism has eleven bounded genes. They describe section order, column count, navigation, chart and order views, palette, typography, spacing, radius and behavior.
The grammar preserves all required sections. Unknown properties, markup, executable code, URLs and unsupported substitutions are rejected before rendering.
The same canonical renderer serves evaluations, the APEX laboratory and this exhibition. Preview frames use a sandbox with an opaque origin.
Inspect the full-size organism and try its filter. Desktop, tablet and mobile views reveal real composition changes, rather than decorative rectangle arrangements.

chapters.title: One hundred recorded generations
captions: Pure Darwin and random search begin with the same seeded population. Both receive twelve candidate slots per generation and the same technical scoring rules.
Play moves through actual stored generations. Pause, step and scrub do not invent intermediate organisms. The chart preserves best-of-generation regressions.
Best-so-far is a separate historical measure. Keeping an elite naturally makes that archive nondecreasing; it does not mean every generation improved.
Repeated phenotypes can reuse observations under the same evaluation fingerprint. The experiment reports candidate slots and unique browser evaluations separately.

chapters.title: Ancestry and mutation under the microscope
captions: The family tree loads a local generation window. Each stored edge points to a real parent, including both parents where crossover combined compatible traits.
Select a node to inspect its genome, eligibility, fitness objectives and ancestry. Zoom and scrolling keep a large population history manageable.
The mutation microscope places parent and offspring side by side. The changed properties come directly from their recorded genomes.
An unchanged elite is labeled honestly. It is inheritance of a successful phenotype, not a new design improvement or a model-generated mutation.

chapters.title: Optional AI, with a spending boundary
captions: Haiku is an optional mutation operator. It cannot execute SQL, change the scoring engine or select its own candidate as a winner.
Paid execution remains disabled in this recording. There is no completed Claude comparison here, and no simulated AI result stands in for one.
The integration reserves a worst-case token budget before a request, reconciles returned usage, retains uncertain charges and stops when a limit is exhausted.
Database tests exercise concurrent reservations, invalid proposals and the scheduler boundary using mocked responses. Credentials belong in an APEX Web Credential, never in browser code.

chapters.title: What the experiment actually found
captions: Five paired seeds completed one hundred generations each. Together they produced twelve thousand, one hundred and twenty candidate records, with complete recorded provenance.
Darwin finished above random search on the declared technical score in all five pairs. The mean final best-so-far difference was about one point.
That result does not prove better usability or beauty. Winners often favored large text and a long single-column layout, exposing what this fitness function rewards.

The open-source repository includes the installer, native APEX application, exact configurations, exported history and verification evidence. Reproduce the experiment, inspect its limitations, and change the objectives.
